rv.q: Such a creation is indeed a special thing, worth seeing and well worth staying for.
This outstanding musical tells the story of a group of 19th-century writer friends who created some of literature’s most famous fiends.
"Monsters of the Villa Diodati" is unmissable, adult Halloween fare.

cn.t: This musical about the 1816 gathering that spawned literary monsters earns praise for its lush, atmospheric storytelling and youthful energy, with critics calling it an outstanding and creepy treat that brings the famous writers' gathering to vivid life.
